context: Scene C spans frames 191-280 (3.75s). Right-stage window x490-1060 y60-1020 with thin border. Three contiguous white artboard cells (570x960) in a vertical strip; page-turn scroll legs are ~0.12s at rel 1.20-1.32 and 2.40-2.52 so each work is centered ~1.1-1.2s plus partial visibility through turns (near-equal slots). Works: 01 ink char gathers in writing order then holds still (guide contour fully fades); 02 same char as vertical gradient with one wave pass then resolves; 03 strokes stream in from both edges forming a mirrored two-wing emblem then holds still. Captions are work names only (筆墨/筆彩/筆構) plus a small red seal. All stroke material is Baseline FUDE S01-S13.
